items.question: 中国籍本科生申请校外住宿的流程是什么？
items.actual_answer_excerpt: 无法确认中国籍本科生的校外住宿规定；命中的国际学生办法不能外推。
confirmed_facts: All three recorded runs retrieve the international-student source and miss the other frozen gold source.
The local 2017 student management snapshot refers dormitory specifics to separate rules and has no domestic off-campus procedure.
items.hypothesis: The frozen gold source list may treat a general dormitory-management reference as relevant evidence even though it does not contain the requested procedure.
items.resolution: Unresolved. Do not tune against this frozen case or add an inapplicable contact as a substitute; acquire a verified current domestic-student source first.
items.answer_review_note: Engineering's follow-up department recommendation is not directly supported in its retrieved snippets; model-judge full marks are not human confirmation.

items.question: 长安大学本科生每学期修读多少学分比较合适？
items.expected_context: 选课学分数超过35学分时，必须经学业导师同意，所在学院审核并报教务处批准。
items.initial_answer_excerpt: 超过35学分……必须经学业导师同意，并由所在学院审核。
confirmed_facts: The correct source ranked first, but the 500-character retrieved chunk ended mid-sentence at '所在学院审'; the model completed the clause beyond the text it received.
A stricter prompt alone did not resolve the issue; the second initial trace preserved the same truncated evidence boundary.
items.change: When the top-ranked same-source chunk ends mid-sentence, append its adjacent chunk and remove the recorded 80-character overlap; the corrected trace adds 420 characters and logs the continuation.
items.resolution: Resolved for this K01 example after adjacent-context expansion; one query does not establish overall retrieval quality.

items.question: 长安大学图书馆官网公开的联系电话和邮箱是什么？
confirmed_facts: The raw retriever ranked two archive pages above the current homepage snapshot for the contact query.
In the frozen10 run, policy-filtered NumPy and Chroma ranked library_home_2026 first; the single-case result does not establish general ranking quality.
items.change: Apply the source index policy that excludes archive_not_for_current_answers from current-answer retrieval.
items.resolution: Resolved for this K10 frozen query in both local retrieval implementations; the raw ranking result remains recorded for comparison.

items.actual_answer_excerpt: 我不能查询或提供其他用户的记录。
items.impact: Safe answer and no cross-user data release; tool-selection and operational completion metrics fail against frozen gold.
items.resolution: Keep frozen gold and report the conflict. Do not prompt the model to probe a record after it has correctly recognized a cross-user request.

items.actual_tool_result: found; current user's synthetic record status returned correctly
items.resolution: Retain 6/8 argument accuracy. Do not require the model to infer an unstated service type; the server resolves the unique matching record inside the trusted synthetic user's scope.
